name: Focus Pull
description: The headline racks into focus from 118% scale and heavy blur, holds with a slow push, and drifts out of focus on exit.
move: The headline racks into focus from 118% scale and heavy blur, holds with a slow push, and drifts out of focus on exit.
how: scale 1.18→1 and blur 26→0 over 1.7s with cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); opacity in 0.8s. A 2s sine.inOut push to 1.035 keeps the hold alive. Exit: scale 0.97, blur 18px, fade, power2.in.
adapt: Works with any one-line statement; keep the hold push under ~4%. Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Lens blur rack focus" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
